dialect.detail: IBM mainframe COBOL; uses RECORDING MODE IS V/F, BLOCK CONTAINS 0 RECORDS, COMP-3, RETURN-CODE special register, GOBACK, ACCEPT FROM DATE/TIME, and COPY with REPLACING - all characteristic of IBM Enterprise COBOL on z/OS
evidence: LICENSED MATERIALS - PROPERTY OF IBM copyright header

purpose.domain_detail: Customer file maintenance - reads sequential transaction file and applies updates (ADD, UPDATE, DELETE) to a sorted sequential customer file with account balance and monthly order data
purpose.summary: SAM1 reads a sequential transaction file and applies ADD, UPDATE, and DELETE operations to a sorted sequential customer master file, writing an updated output file and a transaction report. It calls subroutine SAM2 to apply field-level updates to customer records. The program is part of an IBM educational/lab sample suite (Doug Stout, IBM 2021) used for fault analysis training.

notable_features: COMP-3 packed decimal fields for counters
COPY with REPLACING pseudo-text (==:TAG:==) for record reuse
CALL to SAM2 subprogram for field-level updates
FILE STATUS checking on all four files
Report generation with formatted headers and statistics
